name: AFQ Tract Classification
summary: Classifies major white matter tracts with AFQ (AFQ_SegmentFiberGroups) from a .tck tractogram and dtiInit output and outputs a white matter classification.
description: Imports the tractogram, runs AFQ_SegmentFiberGroups with the dtiInit dt6.mat to label the 20 AFQ major tracts, and writes a classification structure (tract names and per-streamline index) with tract JSON files. useinterhemisphericsplit cuts fibers crossing the midsagittal plane below z=-10 to remove CST fibers crossing at the brainstem. Tractogram and dtiInit must be from the same subject and space. For more information about AFQ see https://github.com/yeatmanlab/AFQ/wiki

inputs.description: dtiInit output; its dt6.mat is used by AFQ to segment the fibers.

outputs.description: White matter classification (classification.mat with AFQ tract names and per-streamline index) and tract JSON files.

parameters.description: If true, AFQ cuts fibers crossing between hemispheres with a midsagittal plane below z=-10, removing CST fibers that appear to cross at the brainstem.

failure_modes.fix: Check the logs; make sure the tractogram and dtiInit come from the same subject.
